name: @red-cup-engineering/alpaca-esther-paper-redistributor-loop
description: Standing PAPER-ONLY daily redistributor for Esther Davis's Alpaca paper account: rebalances a fixed diversified basket (40% SPY / 20% QQQ / 20% TLT / 10% GLD / 10% BIL -- no adopted target-allocation doctrine was found in the federation, so this is the plain basket given directly) toward target weights whenever a symbol drifts more than 2% absolute, capped at 25% of equity turnover per day, bootstrapping a fresh all-cash account over up to 4 daily 25% tranches. Sibling to alpaca-esther-paper-trading-loop; reuses its PAPER-ONLY guards unmodified via alpaca-paper-trading-guards-service. Hard-refuses (nonzero exit) unless the trading host is paper-api.alpaca.markets and the account is verified paper-flagged; refuses outright if any Alpaca *_LIVE_* credential is present in its environment.
